name: capability-grid-section
purpose: A framed grid of claims or links under an optional section title: each cell is a `FeatureItem` (optional glyph, heading, sentence) with optional bullet points, three or four to a row, and an item with an `href` turns its whole cell into a link to that page. It is the one marketing grid of claims or links: it replaces `'use-case-links'`, `'resource-grid'` and `'content-columns'`. From the design sample's site `CapabilityGridSection`. Use CapabilityGridSection for any grid of claims or links on a marketing page; icons and per-item links are optional.
useWhen: A product page listing what the product does, three or six at a time.
Use cases or resources that each link to their own page: give each item an `href` (and no `icon` for a resource list).
A bare grid (no title) under a band that already has its heading.
avoidWhen: For capabilities with art — use `FeatureTilesSection` or `BentoGrid`.
For use cases whose band title sits in the first grid cell with one action — use `CustomerUseCasesSection`.
For cells that each carry their own action or copy button — use `FeatureWidgetsSection`.
bestPractices: Three or six items at three columns, four or eight at four, so rows stay full.
Keep points to three short lines.
Give either every item an `href` or none, so the grid reads as one kind of cell; do not combine `points` with an `href` (the whole cell is the link).

Set `titleAlign: 'start'` for a band whose header sits at the start edge (the Partners page's "Why you should be a partner"); the grid keeps its title, so each capability stays an `h3`. Never wrap a bare grid in `SectionModule` to move the title: the capability headings rise to `h2` and the outline breaks.

props.name: title
props.doc: Headline over the grid, rendered as the band `h2`; without it the grid is bare and each capability heading is an `h2`.

props.name: description
props.doc: One or two sentences under the title.

props.name: items
props.doc: The capabilities, in order; each is `{ title, description, icon?, points?, href? }`; an item with `href` links its whole cell to that page. The band renders nothing when empty.

props.name: columns
props.doc: Capabilities per row from the large breakpoint up.

props.name: primaryAction
props.doc: First button under the section title, `secondary`; `{ label, href, trailing?, target? }`. Shown only with a label and a link.

props.name: secondaryAction
props.doc: Second button under the section title, `outline`; same shape. Shown only with a label and a link.

props.name: anchor
props.doc: In-page id set on the band so a hash link can target it.

props.name: titleAlign
props.doc: Layout of the section title: `center` stacks and centers it, `start` stacks it at the start edge, `split` sets the headline and its description in two columns.
